'''Teleother Lumbridge''' is a [[member]]'s spell which requires a [[Magic]] level of 74 and teleports the target player, who must have [[Accept Aid]] on, to [[Lumbridge]]. A window will pop for the person being teleported asking them if they wished to be teleported. It is used to send you to Lumbridge once you have completed [[Tutorial Island]].
